cd cow && cat > /tmp/drive.py <<'PY'
import subprocess, sys, time, os, select
cmd=['qemu-system-riscv64','-machine','virt','-bios','none','-kernel','kernel/kernel','-m','128M','-smp','3','-nographic','-global','virtio-mmio.force-legacy=false','-drive','file=fs.img,if=none,format=raw,id=x0','-device','virtio-blk-device,drive=x0,bus=virtio-mmio-bus.0']
p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
os.set_blocking(p.stdout.fileno(),False)
buf=b''
sent=False
t0=time.time()
while time.time()-t0<90:
    r,_,_=select.select([p.stdout],[],[],0.5)
    if r:
        d=p.stdout.read(4096)
        if d:
            buf+=d
            sys.stdout.write(d.decode('utf-8','replace'))
            sys.stdout.flush()
            if not sent and b'$ ' in buf:
                time.sleep(1)
                p.stdin.write(b'cowtest\n'); p.stdin.flush(); sent=True
    if sent and (b'ALL TESTS PASSED' in buf or b'FAILED' in buf or b'panic' in buf):
        time.sleep(2); break
p.kill()
open('/tmp/cowtest_out.txt','wb').write(buf)
print('\n=== SENT:',sent,'BYTES:',len(buf))
PY
